d: Doha Bank is seeking an experienced Compliance Officer & Deputy MLRO for our UAE Branch, based in Dubai. This pivotal role reports directly to the Country Compliance Officer & MLRO and plays a key part in ensuring the branch’s adherence to all applicable regulatory and anti-money laundering (AML) requirements in the UAE.
q: Minimum 10 years of experience in banking compliance, AML/CFT, or regulatory risk functions, with at least 3 years in the UAE market.
Proven track record of working with CBUAE regulatory frameworks, AML/CFT laws, FATF guidelines, and sanctions compliance.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus.
Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
High level of integrity, independence, and attention to detail.
r: Support the design and execution of the Compliance Monitoring Plan.
Assist the MLRO in identifying, escalating, and reporting suspicious transactions and activities in line with regulatory obligations.
Monitor regulatory changes (CBUAE, FATF, ESR, AML-CFT) and ensure timely implementation of necessary controls.
Support internal and external audits, and regulatory inspections.
Review and advise on new products, services, and business initiatives from a compliance and AML/CFT perspective.
Conduct training and awareness programs for branch staff.
Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities, internal stakeholders, and group compliance functions.

d: We are seeking a skilled Encryption Engineer with a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in enterprise encryption, data security, and cryptographic key management solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience implementing, configuring, administering, and troubleshooting enterprise encryption technologies to ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and security compliance.
q: Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in enterprise encryption and data security technologies.
Practical experience with enterprise encryption platforms and key management solutions.
Knowledge of Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
Understanding of symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hashing, and digital certificates.
Experience in encryption implementation, administration, troubleshooting, and technical support.
Familiarity with security standards, encryption policies, and compliance requirements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
Experience with enterprise-grade encryption and cryptographic key management environments.
Exposure to database encryption, application encryption, and data protection solutions.
Relevant certifications in information security, cryptography, or enterprise security technologies.
r: Implement, configure, and maintain enterprise encryption solutions for data at rest and data in transit.
Manage the encryption key lifecycle, including key generation, rotation, backup, recovery, and secure destruction.
Administer and troubleshoot Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), key management systems, and enterprise encryption platforms.
Support database, application, file-level, and infrastructure encryption requirements.
Perform installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and maintenance of encryption systems.
Integrate encryption solutions with enterprise applications, databases, servers, and security infrastructure.
Monitor encryption environments, investigate incidents, and resolve technical issues.
Support security audits, compliance assessments, and encryption policy implementation.
Prepare technical documentation, configuration guides, and operational procedures.
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure and reliable encryption services.
